decisions.libraries: Community kits (M3, SDS, iOS...) were available, but their assets used ALL_SCOPES vars and a different API -> build local library matching React names
decisions.cssScheme: WEB code syntax = var(--{prefix}-{path with / -> -}); prefixes: Color -> --color-*, Spacing 'space/N' -> --space-N, Radius 'radius/x' -> --radius-x, Primitives -> --palette-*. design/tokens.css: primitives/spacing/radius + Light colours in :root, Dark colours in [data-theme="dark"], semantic colours as var(--palette-*) aliases
decisions.avatarHues: 12 hue buckets (0..330 step 30), names map: Maya 210, Daniel 90, Priya 120, Tomas 240, Grace 300, Jonah 30, Lena 120, Sam 30, Noor 240, Amara 150, NewPerson 90
decisions.referenceTime: light screens UTC 16:50 -> UTC-4 12:50 PM Afternoon, UTC-5 11:50 AM Morning, UTC-6 10:50 AM Morning, UTC-7 9:50 AM Morning; dark screen UTC 01:05 -> -4 9:05 PM Night, -5 8:05 PM Evening, -6 7:05 PM Evening, -7 6:05 PM Evening
decisions.productName: Product collection holds product/name ('User Management') and product/short-name ('Users'), scope TEXT_CONTENT, WEB code syntax product.name / product.shortName pointing at product.json. AppHeader wordmark (10:180 Desktop, 10:217 Mobile) binds product/short-name; Cover title 43:11 binds product/name. AddSheet save label reads 'Add person' so the name stays out of copy.
decisions.motion: Motion collection: durations motion/fast 120, motion/base 200, motion/slow 320 (FLOAT, ms in CSS) and easings motion/ease, motion/ease-out (STRING cubic-bezier). No scopes, so they stay out of property pickers. tokens.css zeroes the durations under prefers-reduced-motion.
decisions.cardFacts: PersonCard Expanded/Editing show Location and Zip only. Coordinates and Record were dropped (properties deleted): people can't read lat/lon and the record id is internal. Coordinates still place map pins. AddSheet intro reads 'We look up their city and local time.'
decisions.zipValidation: A local GeoNames list says whether a zip is real; the location provider says where it is. Unknown zips can't be saved (AddSheet InvalidZip, save stays disabled). A real zip the provider can't place is saved and flagged PersonCard / CantLocate; a zip that stops being real on a later lookup is flagged PersonCard / InvalidZip. Only provider outages stay PendingLocation and retry. NeedsAttention counts flagged people and filters the grid to them.
decisions.typeUnits: Figma text styles are in px (Figma has no rem). tokens.css writes each as px / 16 in rem, so text follows the reader's browser font size; design/check-tokens.test.mjs checks the conversion. Spacing and radii stay px.
decisions.cardInteractions: A collapsed PersonCard opens from anywhere on it (its own buttons keep their actions). A press outside the expanded card collapses it, except while editing; the actions menu closes on any press outside it. Remove keeps undo (hard delete after the toast closes) rather than a confirm dialog.
decisions.teamTime: Relative to you: PersonCard shows relativeLabel ("3h ahead of you") under the period line and ZoneCell shows relativeShort ("+3h") between time and people, both accent-ink. TimezoneStrip marks the viewer with a ZoneCell State=You cell when no group shares their offset. SortToggle (A–Z / By time) sits after the people count. List view: ViewToggle Grid, List, Map; a PersonTable panel with Person, Local time, Relative, Zip and Actions columns, where flagged people show their status in the Relative column. Desktop / List (next to Desktop / Grid; later screens moved right by 1540) uses the light reference time with the viewer at UTC−8 (8:50 AM), so the You cell comes first and everyone is 1–4h ahead.

ZoneCell.note: relative line (76:649 Default, 76:650 Active) sits between time and people, text/sm accent-ink (on-accent when Active). State=You: dashed 1.5 line-strong border, no fill or shadow; hint "You" and people "Your time" are plain text, Offset/Time stay bound. Instances that existed before have Show relative off, so earlier screens look unchanged.

ViewToggle.note: Segments in order Grid, List, Map in every variant (list segments 75:1787 in Grid, 75:1824 in List, 75:1798 in Map). Figma lists the variant options as Grid, Map, List. AppHeader Device=Mobile hides the toggle labels (icon-only) so three segments fit at 390px.

PersonCard.note: PendingLocation place text is unlinked (edit text directly); Relative line (text/sm accent-ink) under the period line in Default/Expanded/Editing, toggled by Show relative; instances that existed before have it off

AddSheet.note: hint/preview-place/waiting are per-variant plain text; name-field/zip-field/avatar/sky exposed nested instances

TimezoneStrip.note: zone-you (ZoneCell State=You) is the first slot, hidden unless Show you is on; cells have Show relative off by default. Nested path IDs: I<strip>;76:666 (you), I<strip>;10:146/10:152/10:158/10:164 (UTC−7..−4).

MapPin.note: avatar is an exposed nested instance resized to 28px (source dot size); label gap space/20 (chip edge 34px from pin centre). Anchor = avatar centre: Right x=px-14,y=py-h/2; Top y=py-(h-14); Bottom y=py-14

PersonTable.note: PersonTable holds the header plus 8 row instances (default team A–Z at the light reference time, viewer UTC−8, Tomás flagged Can’t locate). Avatar is an exposed nested instance; set hue fills with the resolved-colour paint fallback. Flagged place is plain text; status colour and icon for Location pending (notice, clock) and Zip not found (error, alert) are instance overrides. Actions are 44px icon-only ghost frames (Button has no icon-only variant).

prototype.reactions: 12 direct reactions (ON_CLICK smart-animate; 3 -> 4 AFTER_TIMEOUT 1.2s); no hotspots needed
prototype.annotations: step label above each frame + arrow vectors 1→2→3→4→5, 1→6, 6→7

entities.tokensCss: design/tokens.css (284 properties: 260 variables + --font-family, 16 --text-* styles with -tracking/-case companions, 2 --shadow-*)

lessons: TEXT props on component sets share ONE default across variants; state-specific copy must be plain text or instance overrides
isExposedInstance must be set after appendChild into the component
paint() fallback color should be the resolved value (override equal to main binding rendered black otherwise)
Empty auto-layout frames used as spacers default to 100px tall: always set layoutSizingVertical=FIXED and resize height to 1
Wrapper frames created by createAutoLayout clip content by default; set clipsContent=false on transparent wrappers or card shadows get cut

On a fresh clone, sync inst.mainComponent and getMainComponentAsync-based search did not find nested instances; address nested instances by path ID `I<instanceId>;<componentChildId>` (e.g. ViewToggle = I<AppHeader>;10:186)
Map art: createNodeFromSvg with sentinel colours, then rebind paints by colour to variables
setFileThumbnailNodeAsync is not available to scripts; Figma falls back to the first frame on the first page (the Cover)
Reactions can be set directly on nested instance sublayers (e.g. I<instance>;<child>) - no hotspot fallback was needed
A frame with an explicit Dark mode inside a light table needs its own surface fill, or 'ink' text renders light-on-light
minWidth cannot be overridden on instance sublayers; set it on the component (PersonCard Expanded side column min 260) and override FILL on the instance
A FILL child in a WRAP row has min width 0 and stays on the first line; give it a minWidth so it wraps to its own line before filling
knownLimitations: Prototype: clicking the zip field stands in for typing 02108 (no text input in Figma prototypes)
File thumbnail cannot be set via the plugin API; Figma uses the Cover frame by default
